image_description: A close-up photograph of a butterfly resting on a textured, purple-grey rock surface. The butterfly has its wings partially open, revealing bright orange ventral surfaces with brown borders and distinct white-ringed eyespots (ocelli). The dorsal side visible at the edges appears dark brown. The body is fuzzy and brown. Green foliage is visible in the background.

The connection between the wings and the thorax is somewhat indistinct and muddy, lacking the clear mechanical articulation seen in real insects.
